body:
Spec: .adlc/specs/p0-p1-human-interrogation.md (design D4; read it first — it carries the resolved maintainer decisions and the atomicity requirement).

Today `packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs` passes P1 on `spec-lint` + `premortem` manifest records alone and has no `p0` key at all, so 'Gate: human approves the spec' (ADLC.md:224) is not machine-checked anywhere. Make it so:

1. Port `adlc-approve-spec` from `plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-approve-spec.md` to `plugins/adlc-claude-code/commands/adlc-approve-spec.md`. The command records a `spec-approval` manifest record whose payload includes an interrogation summary: rounds run, questions asked, question sources consumed, `unresolved` count (must be 0), and `approved_assumptions` (residual parallax divergences approved under the D3 round cap — listed, not counted as unresolved).
2. In `packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs`, change the p1 requirement to `['spec-lint', 'premortem', 'spec-approval']` and add a `p0` key requiring `coldstart`.
3. Validate the `spec-approval` payload in the p1 assertion: a record with `unresolved > 0` or missing interrogation fields is rejected.
4. ATOMICITY (non-negotiable, from the adversarial review of the spec): update the existing `plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-approve-spec.md` (and its `commands/` duplicate if present) and `plugins/adlc-opencode/command/adlc-approve-spec.md` to emit the new payload IN THIS SAME CHANGE. They currently emit legacy payloads without interrogation fields; landing the strict assertion without updating them breaks P1 for every non-Claude-Code harness. No legacy-format carve-out in the validator.
5. Release notes / migration note: in-flight P1 work that recorded no approval (or a legacy payload) fails `adlc-runner run p1` after this lands; that is intended.

Acceptance criteria:
- New test asserts p1 fails without a `spec-approval` record and passes with a valid one; verified by `node --test packages/runner/test/`.
- New test asserts p0 requires a `coldstart` record; verified by `node --test packages/runner/test/`.
- New test asserts a `spec-approval` record with `unresolved > 0` is rejected; verified by `node --test packages/runner/test/`.
- Emitters land with the validator: `grep -rl 'unresolved' plugins/adlc-cursor plugins/adlc-opencode --include='adlc-approve-spec.md'` matches both harnesses.
- `test -f plugins/adlc-claude-code/commands/adlc-approve-spec.md` exits 0.
- Full suite green: `npm test` exits 0.
title: Gate 1 machine-checked: spec-approval asserted in p1, coldstart in p0
